description: This file defines a 'DevOverlay' component for a LightningJS application, providing minimal diagnostic info in the UI for troubleshooting during development.

classes.name: DevOverlay
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays diagnostic information such as logs and store status, mainly used for debugging during development.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initial state of the component, including log lines, unsubscribe handler, and visibility flag.

methods.name: mounted
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the component is mounted; sets up log handling and subscribes to store updates.

methods.name: destroyed
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the component is destroyed; cleans up subscriptions.

methods.name: get $alpha()
methods.description: Computed property to control component transparency based on visibility.

methods.name: get $lines()
methods.description: Computed property returning current log lines.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Input action to toggle the visibility of the overlay.
